requirements.nativeVisualStructurePolicy: Diagnostic only. Distinct valid inputs can intentionally render the same geometry, including long-form grammar aliases and reset frames without predecessors.
requirements.rasterDuplicatePolicy: Diagnostic only. Raster hashes can differ because labels differ and can match when distinct valid inputs are visually equivalent.
requirements.captureSourceIdentityPolicy: Both Native and Official capture manifests must bind the requested case ID and visual-parity corpus to the exact expected source SHA-256.
requirements.flowchartTopologyPolicy: Parse every source through Mermaid.js 12.0.0 FlowDB, then compute an identifier-, label-, and shape-independent canonical directed graph fingerprint that retains multiedges and subgraph containment.
